name: dsh-github-publisher
description: One-click GitHub publishing for local DSH plugins: fill in the metadata, prepare README/LICENSE/.gitignore/package.json, create the repo, commit, push, tag and release — from a left-sidebar page. · 一键把本地 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub：自动补全信息、建仓、提交、推送、打 tag 和 Release，左侧栏入口随开随用。

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node tests/verify-static.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/host-sim.mjs && node tests/lib-git.spec.mjs && node tests/lib-github.spec.mjs && node tests/client-smoke.mjs && node tests/client-ssr.check.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
